sources.entry: AI Virtual Staging - AI powered virtual staging for real estate listings

summary.name: AI Virtual Staging
summary.one_liner: An AI tool that adds photorealistic furniture and décor to photos of empty real estate rooms while keeping the original layout and lighting.
use_cases: Staging empty rooms for property listings
Removing dated furniture from listing photos
Converting daytime exteriors to twilight shots
Turning floor plans into furnished 3D renders
summary.what_it_does: The tool takes an uploaded photo of an empty or furnished room (JPG, PNG, or WEBP) and adds furniture and décor in about 20 seconds, producing a 2K or 4K image. Users pick from 12 interior styles and can add custom instructions. The page states that walls, windows, floors, perspective, and lighting are kept as photographed. The toolkit also lists furniture removal, day-to-dusk exterior conversion, 2D-to-3D floor plan renders, and a free listing description generator, all sharing one credit system. The page includes a comparison against virtual staging services and physical staging on cost, turnaround, and commitment.
notable: Output in about 20 seconds, with layout and lighting kept as photographed
12 interior styles plus custom text instructions
One free credit on sign-up; one-time credit packs from $19 with no subscription
Listing toolkit: furniture removal, day-to-dusk, 2D to 3D floor plans
caveats: Paid credit packs start at $19 after the single free credit; one 2K image costs one credit and 4K costs two
Most MLSs require disclosing that a photo is virtually staged, per the page's FAQ
